comparisonText.description: Comparison text displayed next to KPI trend comparison section.

invertTrendDirectionColor.description: Whether or not an increase in the metric will be colored red.

percentage.description:
If true, KPI trend comparison result is also displayed in percentage in addition to the absolute value. Defaults
to false.

invalidValueMessage.description: If trend value is invalid, this message is displayed instead of the trend value.

intervalLength.description:
Length of time period in multiples of {@link UiSdlMetricTileDataSpecSetting#interval} over which we want to calculate
trend indicator value.
Example, if interval is DAY and intervalLength is 5, trend indicator value will be the difference the metric
value at today's date and (today - 5 days) date.

timeHorizon.description: Time horizon for which kpi trend comparison is evaluated, defaults to 12 months.

title: Spec describing how to calculate KPI trend comparison result.
name: UiSdlMetricTileDataSpecKPITrendComparisonBaseSetting
